---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4.6)
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(knitr); library(scales); library(forcats)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank()))
pal <- c("Patient count" = "#4C78A8", "A1c 6.5+ (%)" = "#E45756", "Diabetes CCW (%)" = "#F58518")

read_std <- function(f) vroom::vroom(file.path(params$data_dir, f), col_types = vroom::cols(geography = "c", .default = "?"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ra <- read_std("data_ruca_age.csv.gz")   # County x RUCA x Age
ar <- read_std("data_age_race.csv.gz")   # County x Age x Race

state_of <- c("12" = "Florida", "17" = "Illinois", "39" = "Ohio", "56" = "Wyoming")
ra <- ra %>% mutate(state = state_of[substr(geography, 1, 2)])
ar <- ar %>% mutate(state = state_of[substr(geography, 1, 2)])

age_lv  <- c("<18 Years", "18-24 Years", "25-34 Years", "35-44 Years", "45-54 Years", "55-64 Years", "65+ Years", "Total")
ruca_lv <- c("Metropolitan", "Micropolitan", "Rural", "Unknown", "Total")
ra$age  <- factor(ra$age, age_lv); ar$age <- factor(ar$age, age_lv)
ra$ruca <- factor(ra$ruca, ruca_lv)

# A "leaf" cell has no stratifier at its Total level; the rest are marginals
ra <- ra %>% mutate(level = if_else(ruca == "Total" | age == "Total", "Marginal", "Detailed cell"))
ar <- ar %>% mutate(level = if_else(race_ethnicity == "Total" | age == "Total", "Marginal", "Detailed cell"))

measures <- c(epic_n_patients = "Patient count", epic_pct_a1c_6_5_plus = "A1c 6.5+ (%)", epic_pct_diabetes_ccw = "Diabetes CCW (%)")
flag_of  <- function(m) paste0(m, "_suppressed_flag")

# Long format: one row per cell x measure, with missingness indicators
to_long <- function(d, file_label) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(measures), function(m) {
    d %>% mutate(
      file = file_label, measure = measures[[m]],
      value = .data[[m]], flag = .data[[flag_of(m)]]
    )
  })) %>% mutate(measure = factor(measure, unname(measures)))
}
ra_long <- to_long(ra, "County x RUCA x Age")
ar_long <- to_long(ar, "County x Age x Race")
```

# 1. Dataset overviews
Includes all Patients from 2024 in Illinois, Florida, Ohio, Wyoming
```{r overview}
overview <- function(d, strat, label) {
  tibble(
    Export = label,
    Rows = nrow(d),
    Counties = n_distinct(d$geography),
    `Detailed cells` = sum(d$level == "Detailed cell"),
    `Marginal rows` = sum(d$level == "Marginal"),
    Strata = paste(strat, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
bind_rows(
  overview(ra, c(paste(n_distinct(ra$ruca[ra$ruca != "Total"]), "RUCA levels"), "7 age bands"), "County x RUCA x Age"),
  overview(ar, c(paste(n_distinct(ar$race_ethnicity[ar$race_ethnicity != "Total"]), "race levels"), "7 age bands"), "County x Age x Race")
) %>% kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

```{r overall-plot}
overall <- bind_rows(ra_long, ar_long) %>%
  group_by(file, level, measure) %>%
  summarise(`% suppressed` = 100 * mean(flag == 1), cells = n(), .groups = "drop")

overall %>% filter(level == "Detailed cell") %>%
  ggplot(aes(measure, `% suppressed`, fill = measure)) +
  geom_col(width = .7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", `% suppressed`)), vjust = -.4, size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~file) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = label_number(suffix = "%")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of detailed cells suppressed", title = "Detailed cells suppressed by measure")
```

# 2. Missingness by demographics

```{r by-age}
by_stratum <- function(long, var) {
  long %>% filter(level == "Detailed cell") %>%
    group_by(file, stratum = as.character(.data[[var]]), measure) %>%
    summarise(pct = 100 * mean(flag == 1), cells = n(), .groups = "drop")
}
plot_stratum <- function(df, title, lv = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(lv)) df$stratum <- factor(df$stratum, lv)
  ggplot(df, aes(stratum, pct, fill = measure)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .85), width = .8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = label_number(suffix = "%")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "% of detailed cells suppressed", title = title) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
bind_rows(by_stratum(ra_long, "age"), by_stratum(ar_long, "age")) %>%
  plot_stratum("By age band", setdiff(age_lv, "Total")) + facet_wrap(~file)
```


```{r by-ruca}
by_stratum(ra_long, "ruca") %>% plot_stratum("By rural-urban commuting area", setdiff(ruca_lv, "Total"))
```

```{r by-race}
by_stratum(ar_long, "race_ethnicity") %>% mutate(stratum = fct_reorder(stratum, pct, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  plot_stratum("By race") + scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(25))
```

```{r by-state}
bind_rows(by_stratum(ra_long, "state"), by_stratum(ar_long, "state")) %>% plot_stratum("By state") + facet_wrap(~file)
```


```{r heat}
heat <- function(d, var, title) {
  d %>% filter(level == "Detailed cell") %>%
    group_by(age, s = .data[[var]]) %>% summarise(pct = 100 * mean(epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag == 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(age, s, fill = pct)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f", pct)), size = 3.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F1F5F9", high = "#B5352F", limits = c(0, 100), name = "% suppressed") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "right")
}
heat(droplevels(ra[ra$level == "Detailed cell", ]), "ruca", "Patient count: RUCA x age")
heat(ar, "race_ethnicity", "Patient count: race x age")
```

```{r county-size}
county_n <- ra %>% filter(ruca == "Total", age == "Total") %>%
  transmute(geography, county_total = epic_n_patients, county_total_flag = epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag)
size_bins <- c(0, 100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 1e9)
size_lbl <- c("<=100", "101-500", "501-1k", "1k-5k", "5k-10k", "10k-50k", ">50k")

size_df <- bind_rows(ra_long, ar_long) %>% filter(level == "Detailed cell") %>%
  left_join(county_n, by = "geography") %>%
  mutate(size = cut(county_total, size_bins, size_lbl)) %>%
  group_by(file, size, measure) %>% summarise(pct = 100 * mean(flag == 1), cells = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(size_df, aes(size, pct, colour = measure, group = measure)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~file) + scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = label_number(suffix = "%")) +
  labs(x = "County total patients (Jan 2024)", y = "% of detailed cells suppressed", title = "Suppression falls as county size grows")

county_n %>% mutate(size = cut(county_total, size_bins, size_lbl)) %>% count(size, name = "counties") %>%
  kable(caption = "Number of counties in each size bin")
```
